items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I kind of had some Alberti textures

ctx.x: But that must have been a monumental thing to do for a first orchestration I would think, when you’re twelve?

I think you don’t know it’s hard yet. I’d played a lot of classical piano and I kind of had some Alberti textures and boom-chuck-chuck kind of textures from the pieces that I played and I think I was just emulating kind of what I knew with a nice little Jewish- sounding theme, at least it seemed like to me.
Cool. Does that score still exist?
